name: Stop Asking If You're Valuable.mp4
title: Stop Asking If You're Valuable. Here's the 4-Week Reset.
desc:
Replaying every meeting, wondering if you're actually valuable? That question isn't keeping you safe. It's what's slowing you down. This is a 4-week reset to stop auditioning for the room and get back to the work that makes you valuable, built on attentional control theory, the spotlight effect and the liking gap.

0:00 Am I valuable here?
0:55 The hidden tax
2:17 Why it gets so loud
3:11 The spotlight effect
4:02 The liking gap
4:59 Week 1: Catch the question
5:52 Week 2: Empty the tank
6:54 Week 3: Score the work
7:41 Week 4: Turn the spotlight around
8:27 Your week

Stuck in your own plateau? Clearer View Coaching offers a free intro call: https://tinyurl.com/clearerviewcoaching

Research mentioned: Eysenck et al. 2007 (Emotion), attentional control theory; Gilovich, Medvec & Savitsky 2000 (JPSP), spotlight effect; Boothby et al. 2018 (Psychological Science), the liking gap; Ramirez & Beilock 2011 (Science), expressive writing before exams.

Music: "Spaghettification" by The Grey Room / Density & Time (YouTube Audio Library)
Photos & footage: Pixabay

The Clearer View is created by an NCAA coach and former NCAA athlete. Videos are written and produced with AI assistance. Every topic, story and final cut is chosen and approved by a human. Visuals and narration are AI-generated.
